title: Value bound from bit width
statement: Let $L$ be a positive natural number, and let $w$ be a finite Boolean list whose length is at most the length of the binary expansion of $L$. For every natural number $i$, the binary value of the list obtained by dropping the first $i$ bits of $w$ is at most $2L$.
hypotheses_covered: The length of $w$ is at most the length of the binary expansion of $L$
